# Vendored dependencies

`three.module.min.js` is [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) r186,
bundled and minified into a single ES module.

Copyright © 2010-2026 three.js authors — MIT License.

It is vendored rather than fetched from a CDN so the game loads offline, from a
`file://`-adjacent static server, and from GitHub Pages without a third-party
request. No other third-party code ships with this project.
